summary: virtualenv_site_packages makes a new venv inherit global site-packages; changing it on an existing venv has no effect until it's recreated.
questions: How do I let a virtualenv see system site-packages?
Why didn't changing virtualenv_site_packages affect my existing venv?

answer_card.title: pip virtualenv_site_packages
answer_card.answer_md: `virtualenv_site_packages` (no): inherit global site-packages. Only applies at creation; delete and recreate the venv to change it.
